scope: Static, exhaustive subdivision of the 275 deferred SLPS Unknown entries into screen-oriented clusters. This map selects future writeback and runtime-test units; it does not claim that a cluster has been observed in PCSX2.

writeback_readiness.policy: A group is fixed-span ready only when every decision encodes with the exact P2 font proposal, fits every original NUL-terminated target, and closes over all shared target owners with identical payloads.

classification_policy.user_facing_candidate: The contiguous text cluster has a plausible player-visible screen route and may be promoted after runtime attribution.
classification_policy.mixed_user_and_diagnostic: The cluster combines visible labels with debug, placeholder or internal formatting strings and must be split using runtime or code-reference evidence.
classification_policy.diagnostic_or_format_fragment: The cluster has no safe direct UI route; preserve it until code-reference evidence proves player visibility.
classification_policy.promotion_gate: A production selector requires a hash-locked ISO, native fixture, exact route, before/after captures and confirmation that every promoted ID renders on that route.

groups.label: 战场结束阶段与地图指令尾项
route: Load a native first-battle card with one controllable squad.
Open the map command menu and visit search and end-phase confirmation.
Return to the battle map without advancing the turn.
runtime_assertions: labels and confirmation sentence are Chinese
format fragments remain aligned with dynamic values
cancel returns to the same battle state

groups.label: 系统选项、BGM、控制与地图设置
route: Load the first native intermission card.
Open Options and visit every BGM, vibration, cursor and map-display row.
Toggle each binary and multi-value setting once, then cancel changes.
runtime_assertions: every setting label and value is visible without clipping
ON/OFF and multi-value toggles keep their original behavior
dynamic button hints do not overlap translated labels

groups.label: 教学中的机体数值与地形适应图例
route: Cold boot the candidate ISO and select the tutorial route.
Advance until unit statistics and terrain grades are introduced.
Open the referenced information panel if the tutorial permits it.
runtime_assertions: HP, EN, armor, mobility, accuracy and range labels align with values
terrain letters and grades preserve their compact layout
tutorial progression is not blocked

groups.label: 开局默认主人公与相关名称标签
route: Cold boot and start each protagonist route.
Reach the default-name confirmation without editing the name.
Toggle focus between the visible default-name fields.
runtime_assertions: default labels match the separately written dynamic names
focus and selection frames retain their original dimensions
player-entered names remain editable

groups.label: 战斗准备中的换乘状态与内部警告
route: Open battle preparation and perform a legal reboard operation.
Visit squad status and attack-value displays.
Record any entry that appears only under invalid or debug state.
runtime_assertions: visible reboard and status labels are Chinese
percent and level fragments remain attached to their values
debug-only strings are not promoted without a reproducible trigger

groups.label: 战斗行动、队形与援护限制提示
route: Load a battle fixture with TRI, Wide and support-capable squads.
Attempt every disallowed target, formation and support action.
Dismiss each restriction dialog without changing the fixture state.
runtime_assertions: each restriction message identifies the correct failed action
manual line breaks fit the message box
no restriction path accepts an invalid action

groups.label: 排序表完整性诊断
route: Locate every code reference to the diagnostic target.
Prove whether normal saved-game state can satisfy the branch.
runtime_assertions: the diagnostic is not classified as player UI without a normal trigger

groups.label: 编成中的编号与地形类型选择
route: Open formation with units covering air, land and water movement.
Visit numbered slots and every terrain-type filter.
Change the active filter and return to the full list.
runtime_assertions: terrain-type labels correspond to the filtered units
number and question-mark placeholders keep their alignment
filter changes do not corrupt the squad list

groups.label: 战斗武器选择与使用条件
route: Load a battle fixture containing TRI, combined, post-move and support weapons.
Open weapon selection under satisfied and unsatisfied conditions.
Inspect every displayed failure reason.
runtime_assertions: weapon conditions correspond to actual usability
condition bullets and two-line failure text fit the panel
disabled and enabled weapon rows retain distinct states

groups.label: 快捷指令、容量与取消确认
route: Open quick-command settings from a battle map.
Change one mapping and visit both cursor-context help states.
Attempt to cancel with marks present and decline confirmation.
runtime_assertions: capacity and context labels align with numeric values
confirmation text fits without losing its question
declining cancellation preserves all marks

groups.label: 击坠结算、交涉与援护设置
route: Load a pre-results fixture containing negotiation and support-capable units.
Advance through destroyed-unit settlement and negotiation.
Open support attack setup before leaving results.
runtime_assertions: settlement values retain their correct labels
zero-value negotiation text is complete
support setup opens and returns normally

groups.label: 编成列表、搜索条件与优先顺序
route: Open formation and enter unit search.
Visit type, pilot, performance, ability and squad-bonus criteria.
Toggle priority, clear the criterion and run a zero-result search.
runtime_assertions: list counters and punctuation surround dynamic values correctly
criteria and ON/OFF priority states remain distinguishable
zero-result text fits and returns to search

groups.label: 全改造奖励选择与确认
route: Load a native card immediately before a unit reaches full upgrade.
Open every reward option and inspect the defer path.
Select one reward, reject confirmation, then confirm it.
runtime_assertions: every reward description fits and preserves numeric modifiers
defer text is shown on the correct path
only the confirmed reward changes the save state

groups.label: 小队编成、命名与换乘确认
route: Open squad formation and rename a squad.
Attempt a reboard that would leave one unit without a pilot.
Reject and then accept the resulting confirmation.
runtime_assertions: chapter and turn fragments remain attached to their values
multi-line reboard warning fits the dialog
reject and accept paths preserve their original behavior

groups.label: 驾驶员能力页格式与控制片段
route: Open pilot abilities for a unit with multiple special skills.
Switch between both ability subpages.
Record which control and debug-looking fragments are actually drawn.
runtime_assertions: visible ability labels are Chinese
color and width controls are interpreted rather than printed
internal Set text is not promoted without visible evidence

groups.label: 资料库关卡进度与路线标题
route: Load a native card with multiple completed stages and routes.
Open Library and visit scenario progress.
Move between route headings and completed-stage counters.
runtime_assertions: stage counters preserve their surrounding grammar
route headings align in their fixed frame
completed and incomplete states remain distinguishable

groups.label: 人物机体页的战术状态数值
route: Open pilot and unit information for support, repair and resupply units.
Visit experience, PP, kill-count and next-level panels.
Switch between unit and weapon-property subpages.
runtime_assertions: all metric labels remain adjacent to their numeric values
support attack and defense abbreviations are unambiguous
page switching does not leave stale labels

groups.label: 修理、补给与精神指令目标选择
route: Load a battle fixture with repair, resupply and targetable spirit commands.
Acquire a part or reward if needed to visit the result messages.
Open each target selector and inspect the no-support state.
runtime_assertions: dynamic unit and item names are inserted inside Chinese sentences
repair, resupply and spirit selectors identify the correct target type
no-support state is readable and blocks invalid confirmation

groups.label: 出击小队选择与尺寸格式
route: Load a fixture before squad deployment selection.
Open squad details, size filters and name search.
Select and deselect one squad without starting the stage.
runtime_assertions: placeholder separators and dynamic squad names align
small, medium and large filters return the correct units
selection counts update without stale glyphs

groups.label: 换乘信息与选项子页面
route: Open reboard confirmation for a unit with a sub-pilot.
Inspect melee, skill, ranged and accuracy fields.
Open each option subpage and return without applying changes.
runtime_assertions: main and sub-pilot labels point to the correct rows
stat comparison plus signs align with numbers
formatted option headings do not print raw placeholders

groups.label: 动态名称与数值格式片段
route: Locate all call sites that format these placeholder fragments.
Bind each call site to a player-visible screen before changing bytes.
runtime_assertions: raw percent placeholders never appear on screen
format fragments are not translated independently of their call site

groups.label: 强化部件、装备与出击前操作
route: Open enhancement parts for a unit with equipped and spare parts.
Visit remove, quantity, terrain and marker rows.
Open every predeployment action and then return to intermission.
runtime_assertions: part quantity and possession states match inventory
terrain and marker hints remain aligned
every predeployment action reaches its original destination
